text.p: Viisnurk, Estonia's largest ski maker, said on Monday that it will launch a 10-15 million kroons additional share issue in spring and seek a listing on the secondary list of the Tallinn stock exchange.
The general share holders meeting will be held in Parnu on April 11 to determine the conditions for the share emission, the company said in a statement.
The share issue and the bourse listing will be handled by Hansa Invesments, the company added.
Viisnurk also said that they hope to be on the secondary list in June this year.
Viisnurk is the second largest cross country ski maker in the world with 1996 turnover reaching 154 million kroons and a net profit of 8.1 million kroons.
The company also makes insulation products and furniture with ski manufacture generating almost half of their total turnover.
